tools.name: click
tools.description: Click one element, given by its index or by a pixel position in the screenshot

app.description: The app: its name, its bundle id or the full path of its bundle

element_index.description: The number of the element in the last get_app_state text

x.description: Horizontal pixel position in the screenshot

y.description: Vertical pixel position in the screenshot

mouse_button.description: Which mouse button: left (the default), right or middle.

key.description: A key name, or a chord joined with + (X11 keysym names: a, space, Return, Tab, Control_L+a, Super_L+d). Spaces around + do not matter; Control, Ctrl, Alt and Shift work too. With click: the keys held during the click

duration.description: Seconds to hold each press (0 to 30)

tools.name: drag
tools.description: Drag between two pixel positions of the screenshot

app.description: The app: its name, its bundle id or the full path of its bundle

from_x.description: Where the drag starts: horizontal pixel position in the screenshot

from_y.description: Where the drag starts: vertical pixel position in the screenshot

to_x.description: Where the drag ends: horizontal pixel position in the screenshot

to_y.description: Where the drag ends: vertical pixel position in the screenshot

tools.name: get_app_state
tools.description: Read an app's key window as an accessibility tree plus a screenshot, opening a session for the app first when there is none. Needed once in every assistant turn before any action on that app

app.description: The app: its name, its bundle id or the full path of its bundle

disableDiff.description: Print the whole tree, not only what changed

keep.description: Keep the screenshot for good, as proof (a path without spaces)

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: Show the apps on this Mac: those running now and those used in the past 14 days, with how often each was used

tools.name: paste
tools.description: Paste text into an app's window and put back what was on the clipboard before.

app.description: The app: its name, its bundle id or the full path of its bundle

text.description: The text, exactly. Missing or -: read from stdin

format.description: text, md or html. Defaults to text

tools.name: perform_secondary_action
tools.description: Run one of the secondary actions an element lists

app.description: The app: its name, its bundle id or the full path of its bundle

element_index.description: The number of the element in the last get_app_state text

action.description: A name from the element's Secondary Actions

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press one key or a chord, modifiers and navigation keys included, written the way xdotool writes keys: "a", "Return", "Tab", "super+c", "Up", "KP_0" (the 0 of the number pad).

app.description: The app: its name, its bundle id or the full path of its bundle

key.description: A key name, or a chord joined with + (X11 keysym names: a, space, Return, Tab, Control_L+a, Super_L+d). Spaces around + do not matter; Control, Ctrl, Alt and Shift work too. With click: the keys held during the click

duration.description: Seconds to hold each press (0 to 30)

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll one element up, down, left or right by pages

app.description: The app: its name, its bundle id or the full path of its bundle

element_index.description: The number of the element in the last get_app_state text

x.description: Horizontal pixel position in the screenshot

y.description: Vertical pixel position in the screenshot

pages.description: How many pages to scroll; fractions work (default 1)

tools.name: select_text
tools.description: Select a piece of text in a text element, or put the cursor right before or after it. Give the text as the accessibility tree prints it, Markdown marks included. When it occurs more than once, add the text before or after it as prefix or suffix.

app.description: The app: its name, its bundle id or the full path of its bundle

element_index.description: The number of the element in the last get_app_state text

text.description: The text, exactly. Missing or -: read from stdin

prefix.description: The text just before the wanted text, when it occurs more than once

suffix.description: The text just after the wanted text, when it occurs more than once

selection_type.description: text, cursor_before or cursor_after. Defaults to text

tools.name: set_value
tools.description: Write a new value into an element that is marked settable

app.description: The app: its name, its bundle id or the full path of its bundle

element_index.description: The number of the element in the last get_app_state text

value.description: Replacement value. Missing or -: read from stdin

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type the given text as key presses

app.description: The app: its name, its bundle id or the full path of its bundle

text.description: The text, exactly. Missing or -: read from stdin
